workload_summary: Velvet runs a reranking + personalization microservice in the ad-decision path. Typical request: user segment + recent events (<=128 tokens) -> top-10 candidate rerank. Targets: p95 latency under 60ms, p99 under 120ms at sustained 800 qps with peaks to 2500 qps. Cost sensitivity: target >30% cost reduction vs current infra. Preference for open models (llama-2-13b, falcon-40b variants) with quantization to int8/int4 where quality acceptable. Strong interest in prefix/KV caching to reuse session keys, workload-aware batching (prefer adaptive batching to keep SLO), and automated quantization profiles. Asking Redwood Optimize for batching/caching/quantization recommendations and Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and burst handling.
